scope: Additional visual inspection of the distributed macOS app for the reported purple-sky defect in D750 files 12 and 26; this is not exhaustive pixel, camera, display or performance qualification.

method.surface: Native app, accessibility controls and directly inspected screenshots through UI automation
method.output_proof: Verifica resa finale, sRGB16 PNG/TIFF, native dimensions

observations: The bright exterior opening at the end of the covered street is white, with pale cyan/blue areas, without the former broad magenta cast.
Unsaturated sky visible through the upper roof glazing retains blue in Fit.
The central native detail shows the bright opening, structural borders, street and surrounding buildings; no broad purple-sky cast was observed.
Thin coloured fringes remain visible at some high-contrast borders; their cause was not diagnosed by this visual inspection and their removal is not claimed.
The overexposed sky band at the upper/right side of the portrait image is white in Fit, in both the extended render and completed sRGB16 proof.
Blue glazing in the background building retains its blue appearance; the foreground facade retains its grey and warm tones.
Central facade details were inspected at 1:1 in the extended render. The upper sky was inspected in Fit, not as a separate 1:1 crop.

folder_preparation.interpretation: The initial warning did not reproduce after reopening the folder. Its original cause was not established; this does not certify that all folder-loading failure modes are fixed.

integrity.comparison: SHA-256 of originals and all 15 bundle files; SHA-256 of ordered SQL rows for edits, revisions and asset annotations, read from a consistent SQLite transaction.

limits: Two automated drag attempts did not visibly pan the file 12 viewport; a native-resolution inspection of the upper roof is not claimed.
The observed absence of a broad magenta cast is a visual check, not a calibrated colour measurement or recovered clipped detail.
No source, decoder, bundle, saved photographic recipe or original file was changed for this follow-up.
No new automated suite, export or XPC campaign was run for this visual follow-up; previous numerical results remain in their original reports. No R0-R4/SF0-SF10 gate is closed.
